pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which Chinese word means "where"? (1 mark)
   A. 门 mén
   B. 卧室 wòshì
   C. 旁边 pángbiān
   D. 哪儿 nǎr

2. What does 下 (xià) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Where
   B. Bathroom
   C. To put
   D. Under

3. Which Chinese word means "happy"? (1 mark)
   A. 快乐 kuàilè
   B. 祝 zhù
   C. 月 yuè
   D. 蛋糕 dàngāo

4. What does it mean to listen for gist? (1 mark)
   A. To write every word
   B. To repeat every word
   C. To find the main idea
   D. To stop listening

5. What does 蜡烛 (làzhú) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Candle
   B. Month
   C. To come
   D. Birthday

6. What does 这是什么? ask? (1 mark)
   A. What is this?
   B. Where is it?
   C. Who is this?
   D. When is it?

7. Which Chinese word means "to eat"? (1 mark)
   A. 吃 chī
   B. 肉 ròu
   C. 饮料 yǐnliào
   D. 茶 chá

8. Where is the garden in 花园在房子右边? (1 mark)
   A. Inside the house
   B. Above the house
   C. On the right of the house
   D. On the left of the house

9. What does 再见 (zàijiàn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Goodbye
   B. Classmates
   C. Hello
   D. Good morning

10. Which sentence means "My name is Xiaoming."? (1 mark)
   A. 再见!
   B. 我叫小明。
   C. 谢谢!
   D. 早上好!

11. What does 同学们 (tóngxuémen) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To be called
   B. Teacher
   C. Classmates
   D. Hello

12. What does 床 (chuáng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Bed
   B. Kitchen
   C. House
   D. Cat

13. What does 放 (fàng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Things
   B. Beside
   C. Is at, is in
   D. To put

14. What does 大家 (dàjiā) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Everybody
   B. Month
   C. We
   D. They

15. What does 蛋糕 (dàngāo) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Plate
   B. Friend
   C. Cake
   D. Candle

16. What does 两 (liǎng) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Two (before a counting word)
   B. Tooth
   C. Nose
   D. Foot

17. Which Chinese word means "to speak"? (1 mark)
   A. 耳朵 ěrduo
   B. 笑 xiào
   C. 说 shuō
   D. 牙 yá

18. What does 左边 (zuǒbian) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Sofa
   B. Window
   C. Left side
   D. Living room

19. Which word for a family member has 女 at the start? (1 mark)
   A. 爸爸
   B. 弟弟
   C. 儿子
   D. 女儿

20. Which sentence means "The chair is under the table."? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发在门旁边。
   B. 电视在客厅。
   C. 椅子在桌子下。
   D. 卧室里有床。

21. What does 今天 (jīntiān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Tomorrow
   B. Mosque
   C. Today
   D. School

22. How many strokes does 日 have? (1 mark)
   A. 6
   B. 3
   C. 4
   D. 5

23. Which Chinese word means "plate"? (1 mark)
   A. 盘子 pánzi
   B. 祝 zhù
   C. 月 yuè
   D. 蜡烛 làzhú

24. What does 水 (shuǐ) mean? (1 mark)
   A. To eat
   B. Water
   C. Vegetables
   D. Beef

25. Read the pinyin: wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink tea.
   B. For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   C. This is a banana.
   D. I like to drink tea.

26. How many strokes does 手 have? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 4
   C. 5
   D. 6

27. What does 眼睛 (yǎnjing) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Eye
   B. Shoulder
   C. Ear
   D. Tooth

28. Which Chinese word means "garden"? (1 mark)
   A. 下 xià
   B. 桌子 zhuōzi
   C. 房子 fángzi
   D. 花园 huāyuán

29. Fill in the blank: 浴室在花园____。 (beside) (1 mark)
   A. 下面
   B. 上面
   C. 旁边
   D. 左边

30. What does 门 (mén) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Door
   B. Left side
   C. Above
   D. Bedroom

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: xièxie! (2 marks)

32. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 妹妹 and 米饭. (2 marks)

33. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 星期一 and 几. (2 marks)

34. Write these two sentences in Chinese characters and pinyin: "What is this?" and "This is a banana." (4 marks)

35. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Good morning!" (2 marks)

36. Write in Chinese and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

37. Write the Chinese for "I laugh" and "I cry" with pinyin. (2 marks)

38. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "My friend gives me a gift." (3 marks)

39. Write the difference in meaning between chuáng and chuāng. (2 marks)

40. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 小 and 哥哥. (2 marks)

41. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: diànshì zài zhuōzi shàng. (2 marks)

42. State three rules of stroke order and give an example of each. (3 marks)

43. Write the numbers 1 to 5 in Chinese characters. (2 marks)

44. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I drink tea." (2 marks)

45. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "On Friday, go to the mosque." (3 marks)

46. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: wǒ xīngqīsān qù xuéxiào. (2 marks)

47. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes." (3 marks)

48. Read the pinyin and write the English meaning: jīntiān xià yǔ. (2 marks)

49. Give the Mandarin words for older brother, younger brother and younger sister, with pinyin. (3 marks)

50. Give two reasons why it is important to place household items in their right places. (2 marks)

51. Write the Chinese words for head, hand and foot, with pinyin. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — 哪儿 nǎr
   哪儿 (nǎr) means where.

2. D — Under
   下 (xià) means under.

3. A — 快乐 kuàilè
   快乐 (kuàilè) means happy.

4. C — To find the main idea
   The gist is the main idea of the message.

5. A — Candle
   蜡烛 (làzhú) means candle.

6. A — What is this?
   什么 means what.

7. A — 吃 chī
   吃 (chī) means to eat.

8. C — On the right of the house
   右边 is the right side.

9. A — Goodbye
   再见 (zàijiàn) means goodbye.

10. B — 我叫小明。
   我叫小明。 (wǒ jiào Xiǎomíng.) means "My name is Xiaoming.".

11. C — Classmates
   同学们 (tóngxuémen) means classmates.

12. A — Bed
   床 (chuáng) means bed.

13. D — To put
   放 (fàng) means to put.

14. A — Everybody
   大家 (dàjiā) means everybody.

15. C — Cake
   蛋糕 (dàngāo) means cake.

16. A — Two (before a counting word)
   两 (liǎng) means two (before a counting word).

17. C — 说 shuō
   说 (shuō) means to speak.

18. C — Left side
   左边 (zuǒbian) means left side.

19. D — 女儿
   女儿 is daughter.

20. C — 椅子在桌子下。
   椅子在桌子下。 (yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.) means "The chair is under the table.".

21. C — Today
   今天 (jīntiān) means today.

22. C — 4
   日 has four strokes.

23. A — 盘子 pánzi
   盘子 (pánzi) means plate.

24. B — Water
   水 (shuǐ) means water.

25. B — For breakfast I eat bǐng.
   wǒ zǎofàn chī bǐng. is 我早饭吃饼。, which means "For breakfast I eat bǐng.".

26. B — 4
   撇, 横, 横, 竖钩.

27. A — Eye
   眼睛 (yǎnjing) means eye.

28. D — 花园 huāyuán
   花园 (huāyuán) means garden.

29. C — 旁边
   旁边 is beside.

30. A — Door
   门 (mén) means door.

SECTION B
----
31. (2 marks)
   Answer: Thank you!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

32. (2 marks)
   Answer: 妹妹: mèimei, younger sister. 米饭: mǐfàn, cooked rice.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

33. (2 marks)
   Answer: 星期一: xīngqīyī, Monday. 几: jǐ, which number, how many.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: 这是什么? zhè shì shénme? 这是香蕉。 zhè shì xiāngjiāo.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for each sentence: 1 for the characters and 1 for the pinyin.

35. (2 marks)
   Answer: 早上好! zǎoshang hǎo!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin.

37. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我笑 wǒ xiào; 我哭 wǒ kū.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

38. (3 marks)
   Answer: 朋友送我礼物。 péngyou sòng wǒ lǐwù.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: chuáng 床 is a bed and chuāng 窗 is a window. The tones are different.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each meaning.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: 小: xiǎo, small. 哥哥: gēge, older brother.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Top to bottom (三), left to right (好: 女 then 子), horizontal before vertical (十), 撇 before 捺 (人).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule with an example.

43. (2 marks)
   Answer: 一, 二, 三, 四, 五.
   Working / marking points: 2 marks for all five correct, 1 mark for three or four.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 我喝茶。 wǒ hē chá.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: 星期五,去清真寺。 xīngqīwǔ, qù qīngzhēnsì.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

46. (2 marks)
   Answer: On Wednesday I go to school.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

48. (2 marks)
   Answer: Today it rains.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the general meaning and 1 mark for all the key words correct.

49. (3 marks)
   Answer: 哥哥 gēge, 弟弟 dìdi, 妹妹 mèimei.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with pinyin.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: It keeps the house tidy and safe, and it is easier to find things.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

51. (3 marks)
   Answer: 头 tóu, 手 shǒu, 脚 jiǎo.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.
